# Carelink Psykiatri Roskilde

Carelink Psykiatri Roskilde is a private psychiatric treatment provider in Denmark that appears repeatedly in the national ADHD Database's 2024 quality report (covering the reporting period 01.04.2024–31.03.2025). The facility is singled out in the report's significance summary as a private actor that reports 0% fulfillment of the "coordinating network meeting" indicator, one of several quality benchmarks tracked across Danish ADHD treatment providers [^src2] [^src3].

The clearest documented failing concerns Indicator 4, which measures whether a coordinating network meeting was held within 90 days of treatment start for patients under 18. The national average for this indicator sits at just 20%, far below the development goal of 90%, and Carelink Psykiatri Roskilde reports achieving this in 0 of 8 relevant cases (0%, with a comparison range of 0–37%) [^src2]. The same 0-out-of-8 result, with an identical 0% (0–37%) figure, recurs in a separate table in the report [^src3]. The chunk context accompanying these figures notes that the steering group behind the ADHD Database has identified system-wide barriers — pressure on both specialized psychiatry and the primary sector, geographic challenges, and competing priorities — and has since revised the indicator to instead track contact with a patient's home municipality within 120 days of the start of diagnostic assessment.

Elsewhere in the report, Carelink Psykiatri Roskilde's performance looks markedly different. On a page covering Indicators 5 and 6 (psychoeducation and ADHD medication use for patients under 18), the facility is recorded with a full 8-out-of-8 result and a 100% figure (range 63–100%) [^src1]. In the same section, the report includes a broader claim about private hospitals' medication rates: among patients treated at private hospitals — including Carelink Psykiatri Roskilde alongside [[carelink-psykiatri-kolding|Carelink Psykiatri Kolding]] and [[carelink-psykiatri-viborg|Carelink Psykiatri Viborg]] — between 86% and 100% are treated with ADHD medication [^src1].

Further into the report, covering adult patients, Carelink Psykiatri Roskilde again shows a 0% result on Indicator 10, which measures whether an adult patient's social support needs were assessed within 120 days of treatment start — the first time this indicator has been reported nationally, with a national average of 37% and regional variation of 14–52% [^src4]. By contrast, on Indicator 11 — whether adult patients are on ADHD medication within 120 days of starting a care pathway, also reported for the first time following the ADHD Database's 2024 expansion to adult patients — Carelink Psykiatri Roskilde is recorded at 100% (range 3–100%) [^src5].

Taken together, the mentions paint a picture of an organization with sharply uneven performance across the ADHD Database's indicators: near-total failure on process measures tied to network coordination and social-support assessment, alongside strong or perfect results on medication-related and psychoeducation measures. No relationships to other named entities are recorded for Carelink Psykiatri Roskilde beyond its grouping with other private hospitals in the medication-rate claim.
